benchmark_corpus: Caravan & CAMELS Global Hydrometric Gauge Parameterization Suite
training_target_description: Caravan-parameterized physical rainfall-runoff benchmark simulation (N=5,100 synthetic events)

split_specification.leakage_prevention: Strict seed-isolated out-of-sample partitioning with separate dynamic meteorological realizations. No temporal overlap or basin leakage between splits.

simulator_fit_metrics.loss_function: Mean Squared Error on log1p-normalized discharge (m3/s / Q_mean)
simulator_fit_metrics.evaluation_note: Evaluated against physical rainfall-runoff benchmark simulator equations. Demonstrates neural network learning of hydrologic flow dynamics with zero residual equation variance. Must NOT be presented as real-world noisy in-situ gauge accuracy.

published_literature_real_gauge_benchmar.citation: Kratzert et al. 2023; Nearing et al. Nature 2024
published_literature_real_gauge_benchmar.gauge_noise_factors: Real-world in-situ gauge records exhibit rating curve hysteresis, unmeasured human withdrawals, dam regulations, and instrument calibration drift.

temporal_coverage_audit.post_2020_streamflow_status: No Caravan observed gauge data exists beyond 2020. Operational post-2020 live predictions utilize live ECMWF IFS 9km deterministic numerical weather forecasts and GloFAS 4.0 / ERA5 reanalysis baselines.
